query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_events,
  COUNT(DISTINCT YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(date, '%Y-%m-%d'))) as years_covered,
  MIN(date) as earliest_event,
  MAX(date) as latest_event,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'economic' THEN 1 END) as economic,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'war' THEN 1 END) as war,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'policy' THEN 1 END) as policy,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'humanitarian' THEN 1 END) as humanitarian,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'critical' THEN 1 END) as critical_severity
FROM events;
